messages:
Diego Ramos: Quick triage 1: partners pushed for a single-slide capacity & embargo plan for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Can we get a compact ask list + owners?
Priya Nair: I'll own the slide. Need confirmed SKU counts by region + any microcode/firmware holds. @Vendor - Nvidia any surprises?
Vendor - Nvidia: FYI we have a small subset of H200 SKUs in a queue for microcode validation. ETA 2026-04-18 for patch sign-off. APAC capacity will be constrained first 10 days post-release.
Ethan L.: Noted. For B200: supply is steady but some image tags are still pending. We need immutable tags + SBOM for marketplace gating.
Vendor - AMD: MI300 early bins show thermal throttling at sustained 40k token windows; recommend shipping a quantized variant for initial availability. We'll post perf numbers by EOD.
Diego Ramos: Good. Proposed public embargo window: 10 calendar days pre-announce plus a mandatory 48h canary on our infra. Partners ok with that?
Vendor - Nvidia: 10 days is fine but we request a 72h verification window for image signoff.
Priya Nair: We can negotiate 72h for image signoff, keep 48h canary for traffic. I'll reflect in the slide.
Ethan L.: Canary policy we should standardize: Stage smoke (24h), Limited prod (48h @ 5% traffic), metrics: p95, p99, error-rate, token-cost delta. Auto-fallback triggers: 5xx > 0.2% or p99 > baseline * 1.25.
Platform Ops Bot: Canary workflow created: canary-5098765432. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary. Status will post results to #eng-oncall.
Vendor - AMD: We'll supply mi300-quant and mi300-fp16 tags + SBOM by 2026-04-12. Expect initial throughput ~ -12% at 48k vs target.
Priya Nair: Action items: (1) Vendors post immutable tags & SBOMs (2) Diego to publish embargo slide (3) Ethan to codify canary triggers in ops config (4) Platform Ops to wire alerts to marketing/legal.
Diego Ramos: I'll drop the slide here by EOD tomorrow and ping marketing for calendar alignment. Please include one-liner fallback messaging we can share with SIs.
Ethan L.: Fallback one-liner suggestion: "If H200/MI300 capacity constrained, traffic will be routed to H100/B200 variants with expected perf delta; see partner one-pager for details."
Priya Nair: Example curl for SI canaries to include in one-pager: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/predict -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"h100-v1","input":"test sequence","max_tokens":512}'
```
Platform Ops Bot: Reservation: promo slots reserved in us-west & eu-west for 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-30. Reminder: legal embargo checklist required 5 business days prior to public.
Diego Ramos: Thanks all. If vendors can drop tags by tomorrow morning we can keep the proposed calendar. Otherwise we move the public date out. :thumbsup:
